title: The stakeholder wants an agent for a single fixed write
prompt: The requirement is one validated write into an internal system, on demand, no schedule. What do you propose?

options.text: A custom action, because it is deterministic execution against an internal API with validation before the write.
options.feedback: Correct. Custom actions cover internal APIs Glean does not support out of the box, legacy systems, and approvals or validation before writing to a system.

options.text: An agent with an MCP tool chosen at run time, so it stays flexible.
options.feedback: This adds nondeterminism to a requirement that asked for one fixed write, and MCP tools are not available as individual single-step selections in Agent Builder.

options.text: A skill, so the methodology is reusable.
options.feedback: Skills carry reasoning and methodology. They do not perform the validated system write this requirement needs.

takeaway: Use custom actions when you want precise, governed execution for a known operation.
